request.lower_description: Dungeon Matcher violet-gray dressed stone, a traditional side-view 2D platformer ledge made of LARGE intact rectangular slabs. Quiet broad matte planes, dark indigo joints, muted purple gray base, subtle lavender top-left light. Horizontal straight stone courses, sparse one-pixel chips only. Very low noise. No rounded cobblestones, no rubble, no dirt, no grass, no ornament, no cracks running through every slab. Side elevation, never isometric or a receding room floor.
request.transition_description: A very shallow flat horizontal walking surface on top of the stone ledge, one single row of wide rectangular violet-gray capstones. Thin restrained lit upper bevel, quiet broad top plane, dark narrow back seam. Constant level contact edge, no bumps or slopes. Only 1 or 2 clean lighting planes, no gritty texture.
